verdict.rationale: Skills are plain filesystem artifacts. They can be distributed from your own self-hosted marketplace (git repos or local paths), and they follow an open, cross-tool standard. A hands-on probe confirmed the official repo's skills install keylessly with third-party tooling and no Anthropic account. However, the skills still run inside Claude Code, the Claude API or another agent runtime, and the API path runs them in Anthropic's code execution container, so 'self-hosting the core product' is only partly in the user's hands. Missing for 10: a documented fully self-hosted runtime independent of Anthropic-hosted models or containers, and first-party self-hosting deployment guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: support for multiple source types, including git repositories and local paths
Claude Code skills follow the [Agent Skills](https://agentskills.io) open standard, which works across multiple AI tools.
